name: Blood Moon Tycoon
desc:
New Infected Arsenal! 🔫 The Ruby Shop is finally expanding with powerful new Infected Weapons! Get your hands on these now and prepare for what's still to come...

Super Duper Yacht Update! 🛳️ Check out the new and improved Yacht now featuring Boats, new Weapons, a Luxury Hot Tub and more! ⚓

BUILD and expand your massive base as you unlock new gear and upgrades! 

FIGHT off the undead and other survivors as you prepare for the dangers that come out at night! 

SURVIVE the challenging Blood Moons with, or without, other survivors and you will be rewarded! 

Follow me on Twitter for codes, update news & more!
